checkpoint().notice: Records a cumulative-price observation if at least         CHECKPOINT_MIN_INTERVAL has passed since the previous one.         Permissionless; no-op when called too early (never reverts on         cadence).

pair().notice: The canonical Uniswap v2 pair being observed.

twapMaxWindow().notice: Maximum valid TWAP window in seconds (4 hours).

twapMinWindow().notice: Minimum valid TWAP window in seconds (30 minutes).

twapNetUsdg().notice: Time-weighted NET price in WAD USDG per whole NET over a         window within [TWAP_MIN_WINDOW, TWAP_MAX_WINDOW]. Reverts if         no observation lands in the band (fail-closed).
